name: find_similar_panels
description: Finds visually similar panels to a target panel using SAM3 image embeddings. Use this when the user asks to 'find panels similar to this one', 'show me similar panels', 'find panels like panel-1', or wants to see visually related content. Returns panels with similarity scores.

target_element_id.description: The semantic ID (e.g., 'panel-1') or direct panel ID of the target panel to find similar panels for. If not provided, uses the currently selected panel.

threshold.description: Minimum similarity threshold (0.0-1.0). Higher values return more similar panels only. Default: 0.7

limit.description: Maximum number of similar panels to return. Default: 10
